faqs.q: Who can apply for the Seed Funding Opportunity?
faqs.a: All full-time undergraduate, postgraduate, and PhD students of GJUS&T Hisar with an innovative idea or early-stage startup can apply. You can apply individually or as a team.

faqs.q: How much funding can I get?
faqs.a: Selected projects receive seed funding of up to ₹1.5 lakh, along with mentorship, workspace, laboratory access, and institutional support from PDUIIC.

faqs.q: Do I need a registered company to apply?
faqs.a: No. Ideas and early-stage prototypes are welcome. The program is designed to help you go from idea to venture — registration and incorporation are steps we mentor you through later.

faqs.q: How does the selection process work?
faqs.a: Applications are screened by the PDUIIC committee, and shortlisted teams are invited to present their idea in an offline presentation round before the evaluation panel. Selections are based on innovation, feasibility, and impact.

faqs.q: What can the funding be used for?
faqs.a: The grant supports prototype development, materials and components, software and tools, testing, and other approved project expenses. Fund utilization is guided and reviewed by your assigned mentors.

faqs.q: What support do I get besides money?
faqs.a: Funded teams get dedicated mentorship from faculty and industry mentors, workspace at PDUIIC, access to the Idea Lab, and connections to the wider startup ecosystem including incubators and government schemes.

faqs.q: How do I apply or ask a question?
faqs.a: Watch the Updates section on this page for the current application window and form link. For any query, email support@iconnectgjust.in or reach us on WhatsApp at +91 9467905906.
